title: SDK Samples Garden — mid-sprint check-in and action log
content:
Meeting: SDK & Samples Garden mid-sprint check-in
Date: 2026-08-12 10:30am PT
Attendees: Maya Chen (host), Lena Park, Omar Vasquez, Ethan Rios, Joao Silva (guest from solutions eng)

TL;DR:
- Quick status on samples-garden refresh and new quickstart flow for Python/JS.
- One blocker on the example telemetry hooks (see DX-482).
- Decision to postpone the interactive notebook until next sprint, focus on smaller tutorial CLI and docs.

Notes / Updates by owner:
- Maya: finished first pass of the quickstart README scaffold; template now supports stream and non-stream modes. Need final wording for "cost expectations" section (placeholder). Linked PR: #189.
  - TODO: add code comments about kv-cache warmup example (owner: Maya, due 2026-08-16)

- Lena: samples-garden web demo rebuilt with new layout; reduced bundle size by removing large demo data. Found two flaky Cypress tests — created issue in repo. Working on adding a small live demo using hosted API sandbox tokens.
  - Note: sandbox tokens expire quickly; we should decide whether to embed a time-limited demo key or swap to a demo proxy (security ask for product). Raised in Slack #devexp.

- Omar: SDK telemetry hook spike — basic metrics emitted (latency, token_count, model_variant). Blocker: telemetry schema mismatch with observability (DX-482). Proposed interim mapping layer in SDK.
  - Action: Omar to open mapping PR and coordinate with observability (owner: Omar, due 2026-08-14).

- Ethan: sample quickstarts for embeddings and reranking — drafted two minimal notebooks. Performance notes: embeddings quickstart hits rate limit when run with default parallelism; added note to README recommending small batches.
  - Suggestion: add a tiny shell script to apply backpressure for demo runs.

Guest notes (Joao): solutions-eng wants a "one-file deploy" example for Dedicated customers that shows model pinning + rollout metadata. Joao to provide concrete customer use-case next week (linked Jira: DX-497).

Decisions:
- Interactive notebook (full tutorial) moved to "parking lot" for this sprint; publish smaller CLI-driven tutorial + short web demo instead.
- Sandbox demo: move to a demo-proxy approach; engineering to scope infra cost and security review (owner: Maya + infra).

Blockers / Risks:
- Telemetry schema mismatch (DX-482) prevents end-to-end dashboards for sample demos. Without mapping, examples look broken to non-engineers.
- Demo proxy requires SRE/infra sign-off; if delayed, user-facing demo could slip.
- Old quickstart (v0) still referenced in multiple READMEs — risk of confusing new users. Need a small script to update README links across repos.

Action items (owner / due / status):
- Omar: PR for telemetry mapping layer (due 2026-08-14) / in_progress
- Maya: finalize quickstart "cost expectations" blurb and add kv-cache comments (due 2026-08-16) / todo
- Lena: fix Cypress flake + add demo proxy proposal to infra (due 2026-08-18) / todo
- Ethan: add backpressure shell helper and update embedding quickstart (due 2026-08-15) / todo
- Joao: provide Dedicated one-file deploy example spec (due 2026-08-19) / todo

Notes to self / drafting fragments:
- Quickstart flow idea: detect environment (local vs hosted) and show conditional snippets. Keep copy short: "If you have a Redwood key, run X. Otherwise, click the demo."
- Consider renaming "samples-garden" -> "sample-playground"? Pros: friendlier. Cons: lots of links to change. Park decision.
- We should include a tiny cost estimator in the readme: e.g. sample outputs ~50 tokens per run, ~0.01 USD (placeholder). Need product to validate numbers.

Parking lot / future ideas:
- Interactive notebook with embedded telemetry chart and example rollouts (stretch).
- Guided tutorial video (30–60s) to embed on the quickstart landing page.
- Auto-generated snippet for CDN-embedded demo (security concerns).

References / Links mentioned in meeting:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/189
- Samples issues: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples-garden/issues/56
- Jira: DX-482, DX-497
- Slack: #devexp thread (ts: 1712900000.000200)

Next check-in: informal async update in #devexp on 2026-08-14; next synchronous mini-standup 2026-08-19 10:30am PT.

End of notes.
